description: This file defines a class for a dataset representing a vector function, generating points based on external functions for x and y coordinates over a parameter t. It is part of the Image_Graph package, specifically within the Dataset subpackage.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_VectorFunction
classes.description: A dataset class for vector functions, generating points from parametric functions for x and y over a range of t.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_VectorFunction
methods.description: Constructor initializing the vector function dataset with range and function names.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Method to add a point to the dataset (currently empty).

methods.name: _getPointX
methods.description: Private method to compute the x coordinate using the specified function.

methods.name: _getPointY
methods.description: Private method to compute the y coordinate using the specified function.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the internal dataset pointer to the start.

methods.name: _stepX
methods.description: Calculates the interval between points based on t range.

methods.name: _calculateMaxima
methods.description: Calculates the min and max values for x and y over the t range.
